name: Visa-exempt entry (ROP list 1)
summary: Citizens of about 80 countries can enter Oman without a tourist visa. That covers most of Europe, the Americas' bigger economies, and countries like Japan, Australia, Canada, the US, the UK, Russia, China, South Korea and Singapore. The ROP page does not give the allowed stay, so check before you go.

other: Official list 1 has 44 European, 10 South American and 26 other countries and regions. See the ROP page for the exact list.
Allowed stay length is not shown on the ROP list page.

sources.label: Royal Oman Police, visa exempt page

name: Visa-exempt entry for holders of a US, Canada, Australia, UK, Japan or Schengen visa
summary: Citizens of 24 listed countries can enter without an Oman tourist visa if they hold a valid visa from the USA, Canada, Australia, the UK, Japan or a Schengen country. Examples on the list: India, Egypt, Jordan, Mexico, Morocco, Vietnam, Peru and Panama.

other: Passport must be from one of the 24 countries on ROP list 2.
Allowed stay length is not shown on the ROP list page.

sources.label: Royal Oman Police, visa exempt page

name: Tourist eVisa (unsponsored, sponsored and express)
summary: Apply online on the official Oman eVisa portal. Types are unsponsored tourist, sponsored tourist, GCC resident tourist and express. Apply at least 4 days before you travel. Your passport needs 6 months of validity. Road travelers also apply online first.

other: Eligible nationalities, stay length and fees come from the eligibility wizard and were not read here.
Passport valid at least 6 months before entry.
Sponsored visa needs a sponsor living in Oman.
Seafarers and cruise passengers still use the traditional system.

steps: Register on the Oman eVisa portal.
Use the visa eligibility wizard to see which visa types you can get.
Fill in the application and upload documents (files under 512 KB).
Pay and wait for the decision. Payment does not guarantee approval.
processing: Official advice: apply at least 4 days in advance.

stay.note: Visa must be used within 1 month (unsponsored and express) or 3 months (sponsored) of issue. Length of stay not confirmed.

name: Tourist visa for GCC residents
summary: People living in Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia or the UAE can use type 29A (main traveler with an approved profession) or 29B (companion). Non-GCC residents visiting from Dubai or Qatar can use a joint visa applied for on paper, which is free if you come straight from there.

other: Approved profession needed for the main traveler under type 29A.
Fees and stay length not confirmed.

name: 10-Year Golden Residency (Investor)
summary: A renewable 10-year residency for investors, entrepreneurs and high-net-worth people who put at least OMR 200,000 into Oman. Apply on the official residency portal.

investment.note: Minimum capital, through one of the approved routes

other: Routes: real estate in Integrated Tourism Complexes, forming a company in Oman, government development bonds, shares on the Muscat Stock Exchange, a fixed-term deposit in a licensed Omani bank, a business employing at least 50 Omani citizens, or nomination by a company under the Foreign Capital Investment Law as key personnel or partner.
Family inclusion and other conditions not stated on the page we read.

steps: Apply through the official Oman residency portal (omanresidence.gov.om).

sources.label: Invest Oman, Golden Residency launch article

name: Work visa (employer sponsored)
summary: An Omani employer requests the work visa for you. It lasts 2 years from the stamp date and allows multiple entries. You must be 21 or older, and a Ministry of Manpower labour permit is needed unless a government body invites you. Some jobs (teaching, medical, media, engineering) need extra approvals.

other: Sponsor must be a local with full legal capacity.
Job and gender on the visa must match the labour permit.
Medical certificate needed for nationals of India, Pakistan, Philippines, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Egypt, Sudan, Ethiopia, Syria and Nepal.
If you worked in Oman and left less than 2 years ago, you need a release letter from the old employer.

name: Family joining visa
summary: An expat employee can bring a spouse and children under 21. A foreign wife of an Omani citizen can also get it. The visa is valid 2 years from the passport stamp and allows multiple entries.

income.note: Minimum monthly salary of the expat sponsor

other: Expat sponsor must hold a senior job by GCC standards.
Sponsor must live in a home rented in their or their employer's name.
Marriage certificate must be authenticated by the Oman Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
For an Omani's foreign wife: Ministry of Interior approval of the marriage plus an embassy-authenticated certificate.

sources.label: Royal Oman Police, Family Joining Visa

name: Student visa
summary: A licensed school or training institute requests the visa for you. Use it within 6 months of issue. You can stay 1 to 2 years from entry, and renew if you keep studying.

other: The institution must be approved to host foreign students and applies for you.
Passport valid at least 6 months.
Medical certificate needed for nationals of India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Philippines, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Egypt, Sudan, Ethiopia, Syria and Nepal.

stay.note: 1 to 2 years from the date of entry

name: GCC citizen rights in Oman
summary: Citizens of GCC states get special entry and work rights in Oman. We could not read an official Omani page giving the details, so the exact rights are not confirmed.

other: Exact rights not confirmed from an official page.
